OPENCTI_URL.description: The base URL of the OpenCTI instance.

OPENCTI_TOKEN.description: The API token to connect to OpenCTI.

CONNECTOR_SCOPE.description: The hunt platform the connector executes against.

CONNECTOR_LOG_LEVEL.description: The minimum level of logs to display.

CONNECTOR_SECURITY_PLATFORM_NAME.description: Name of the OpenCTI Security Platform the hunts are executed against.

CONNECTOR_SECURITY_PLATFORM_TYPE.description: Type of the OpenCTI Security Platform the hunts are executed against ('XDR' when the Singularity Data Lake also holds third-party data you hunt).

CONNECTOR_MAX_CONCURRENT_RUNS.description: Maximum number of hunt runs OpenCTI may dispatch to this connector at the same time (a run holds one query on the platform at a time). The platform budget is the minimum of its own setting and this value. Defaults to 3: SentinelOne throttles query launches and does not document the concurrent query budget of an account.

CONNECTOR_OBSERVABLE_TYPES.description: Observable types the connector may create from hunt results, intersected with the types expected by each hunt. Defaults to IOC types only; supported values: IPv4-Addr, IPv6-Addr, Domain-Name, Url, StixFile, Email-Addr, Hostname, User-Account, Mac-Addr.

CONNECTOR_MAX_OBSERVABLES.description: Maximum number of observables created per hunt run (the most frequent first).

SENTINELONE_HUNT_API_URL.description: URL of the SentinelOne management console of your tenant, e.g. 'https://your-tenant.sentinelone.net'.

SENTINELONE_HUNT_API_TOKEN.description: API token of a SentinelOne service user with a read-only role that can search events (e.g. Viewer) on the accounts or sites to hunt.

SENTINELONE_HUNT_ACCOUNT_IDS.description: Account IDs the hunts search, comma-separated. Empty searches every account the token can reach.

SENTINELONE_HUNT_EDR_ONLY.description: Restrict translated Sigma rules and indicator lookups to the SentinelOne EDR telemetry (dataSource.name='SentinelOne' dataSource.category='security') and check their field names against the EDR schema, so that a misspelled field fails the run instead of matching nothing. Set to false to also search the third-party data of the Singularity Data Lake.

SENTINELONE_HUNT_VERIFY_SSL.description: Whether to verify the TLS certificate of the console.

SENTINELONE_HUNT_SIGMA_PIPELINE.description: pySigma pipeline translating Sigma rules: 'sentinelone_pq' (the field mapping of the SentinelOne EDR telemetry) or 'none' (rules already written with SentinelOne field names).

SENTINELONE_HUNT_POLL_INTERVAL.description: Seconds between two status checks of a query. SentinelOne drops a query that is not polled for 30 seconds.
